title: Driveways
summary: Block paving, tarmac, resin and gravel driveways laid on proper foundations so they stay level for years.
intro: A new driveway adds kerb appeal, value and practical parking space. We dig out, build a solid sub-base and finish with the surface that suits your home and budget.
body:
## Built from the ground up

Most driveway problems start underneath. Sinking, cracking and weeds usually mean the sub-base was too thin or badly compacted. We excavate to the right depth, lay a compacted Type 1 sub-base and add drainage so water goes where it should.

## Surfaces we install

- **Block paving**: hard-wearing and easy to repair, with plenty of colours and patterns
- **Tarmac**: a smooth, cost-effective finish for larger areas
- **Resin bound**: a modern, permeable surface that's low maintenance
- **Gravel**: a quick, natural-looking option with good drainage

We also build edging, kerbs, steps, dropped kerbs (with council approval) and matching paths and patios.
